answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The jade holds work receipts rather than names, so the oasis of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lotus of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
